## Why visit

A useful brewery-focused stop in the Goose Green cluster, particularly when combined with the Dunham Apple Barn or a wider Altrincham afternoon. The attraction is the chance to compare several Dunham Massey cask beers in one place, in a straightforward modern bar rather than a heritage interior. Its local brewery connection makes it more relevant to this trip than an interchangeable craft bar. Pair it with Beacon for a broader producer mix, and treat food elsewhere in Altrincham as a separate decision unless a current menu is confirmed.
